component.name: Hardware Monitor for COSMIC™
component.summary: Monitor CPU, GPU, memory and storage from the COSMIC™ panel

description.p: A native hardware and thermal monitor applet for the COSMIC™ desktop. It sits in the panel showing a thermometer tinted by thermal state alongside the current CPU temperature, and opens into a full monitor.
Readings come straight from the kernel — no daemon, no helper service, and no lm_sensors dependency.

ul.li: Overview: CPU, GPU, memory and disk dials, network throughput, load averages and uptime
CPU: package temperature, utilisation, average clock, power draw, and a per-core grid with live clocks
GPU: utilisation, clock, power draw, edge and junction temperatures, and VRAM usage
Memory: physical and swap usage, committed and cached, with a history chart
Storage: disk throughput and per-partition free space

description.p: AMD and Intel CPUs are read through hwmon. GPU support covers AMD through sysfs, NVIDIA through nvidia-smi, and Intel integrated graphics.
